author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
(Left mine, right original. Open in new tab to get full experience!)


Hello! It's been a while since I released a map.

Today, I want to introduce to you a new concept on Avicus about "Remixing". Basically, you take the work of another author, and spin it off into your own style. I will be adding these if you'd like, however keep in mind the original author, if requested, is allowed to take down your map (so if Jessamania hated this, he'd post and I'd remove it!). I got the idea based off of music and the EDM scene in general, and why not allow even more creativity into edits of other maps? Note that even though I was working on a TE version, this is not the one.

There's a ton of changes, so just look at the comparison screenshot for an overview of them! Quite a few.

So, this is a CTW. You have to take the wool (orange) back to a tower at front lines to win. The monuments have been made to enchanting tables, and there are XP bottles hidden throughout the map. I fixed some inconsistencies from the original such as unfilled areas and misplaced blocks, so enjoy. I'll need to test this to have everyone see the map, the screenshots don't do it justice with it's confusing tourney layout thing. (Yes, those are spawntunnels.)

@Mods: There's a LITTLE amount of TNT, please be warned. They come at 16 a stack and they will go by quick anyway, however keep in mind there may be teamgriefing happening from time to time. Please stay tuned on any updates that may resolve TNT griefing.

Image Album (Doesn't seem to be as extensive as I thought...)
YAML (Coming to a post near you.)
Download (No, sorry.)
